name: Simulator v2.1-running Phase 1 history experiment
seed_provenance: User approved reuse of the five seeds frozen for v2 Phase 1 (SIMULATOR_V2_PHASE1_FREEZE.json); v2.1 dry-run seed 20260921 remains preserved separately
model: Ridge with train-only median imputation/standardization; alpha selected by validation MAE and refit on train+validation; ID-test used only after selection
parameter_recovery: Audit-only unbounded Ridge; one E1-time history row per subject, no current E sensor or target; validation RMSE selects alpha; train+validation refit; held-out subject ID-test
naturalistic_prediction_support: completed evaluation sessions only; no supra-threshold generalization claim
ci_method: two-sided Student t across five independent seed-level results, df=4
paired_difference: same seed and same ID-test subject/session; positive k0 MAE minus k MAE means history improves
